Players Committee card image of [[Jedha: Jedha City (ALT) (Errata 2)|Jedha: Jedha City (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Baze, Chirrut, and Saw deploy -1 here. '''Dark Side:''' May be deployed instead of Alderaan by Set Your Course For Alderaan.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jedhajedhacity_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
